In a rectangle, one diagonal is inclined to one of its sides at 35°. Find the measure of the acute angle between its two diagonals. Ans A). 70° B). 35° C). 55° D). 63° Correct Answer: A

Two inlet pipes A and B can fill a cistern in 20 hours and 15 hours, respectively. A third pipe C, acting as an outlet, can empty the completely filled cistern in 30 hours. All three pipes are opened simultaneously in the empty cistern. After 4 hours, pipe B is closed. After a further 2 hours, pipe A is also closed, while pipe C continues to operate by itself until the cistern is emptied. Find the duration for which pipe C worked alone. Ans A). 10 hours B). 11 hours C). 13 hours D). 12 hours Correct Answer: B
